claim: For fixed p in (0,1), ordinary triangles T_n counted once in G(n,p), and every positive integer sequence q_n, max over all residues a of |q_n P(T_n = a mod q_n)-1| tends to zero if and only if q_n=o(n^2). Triangle standard-deviation normalization starts at n>=3; the known ordinary 2K2 supplement starts at n>=4.
